title: feat(spec): a joined report's block headings and a master-detail field's inline grid heading are translatable
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBBHHmbAUS4ebUhc4iQ5UTie)_
Fixes #26112
Fixes #26142

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed #26759 — `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (the `fields.{field_name}` row and the `reports` sentence) misses `inlineTitle` and `reports.{report}.blocks.{block}`; `skills/**` is Tier H, so the two-line edit rides that card after this PR lands

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:翻译包新增两个槽位——联合报表每个区块的标题/说明(`reports.REPORT.blocks.BLOCK.label` / `.description`),以及主从字段的内嵌表格标题(`objects.CHILD.fields.FIELD.inlineTitle`);服务端翻译器按请求语言覆盖,`os i18n extract` / `check` 也开始统计这两个键。
- 为什么改:中文用户打开联合报表时标题是中文、区块标题却是英文;新建表单上的内嵌子表标题(如「Line Items」)也一直是英文,因为翻译包根本没有地方放这些译文,覆盖率检查也看不到缺口。
- 风险与回滚:只新增可选键,已有翻译包与元数据不受影响;组织自行改过的区块标题或内嵌标题仍保留原文(与报表标题同一规则)。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`(`translateReportBlocks` 与 `translateObject` 字段处理中的 `inlineTitle`)、`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`(两个新槽位)、`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`(`walkReports` 与字段遍历)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/zh-cn-report-blocks-inline-titles.test.ts`,预期 3 个用例通过:示例应用的联合报表区块显示「未完成任务 / 已完成任务」,发票与费用报销的内嵌表格标题显示「发票明细 / 费用明细」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Spec face** (`translation.zod.ts`): `FieldTranslationSchema` gains `inlineTitle`; the `reports` group gains `blocks`, a record keyed by the joined block's required `name`, closed at `label` / `description` (aliases `name` / `title` / `heading` onto `label`).
- **Serving translators** (`i18n-resolver.ts`): `translateReport` overlays each block through a new `translateReportBlocks`; `translateObject`'s field pass overlays `inlineTitle`. Both follow the packaged-base rule (ADR-0029 D9.2a), judged per block (matched by `name`) and per field. A document whose blocks and fields the bundle does not address comes back as the same reference.
- **Landing point, measured:** both labels already reach the console as the served document. The joined renderer (`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`) draws `block.label` off `GET /meta/report`, and `attachInlineSubforms` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`) copies the child field's `inlineTitle` off `GET /meta/object`, both localized at the REST boundary. So the fix lands in the two translators, and neither ui file changes.
- **#26142 fallback decision:** no fallback to the child object's translated plural label. An authored `inlineTitle` with no entry keeps its authored text, because a bundle translates an attribute and never swaps another attribute in over authored text (the rule `pages.PAGE.title` follows). An absent `inlineTitle` already renders the child's translated label.
- **Extract / check** (`i18n-extract.ts`): `walkReports` walks `blocks[]`, the field walk emits `inlineTitle`, both via `pushOptional` (a block without a `label`, or a field without an `inlineTitle`, is recorded and never demanded). `os i18n check` counts them through the same entries: blocks in the report bucket, `inlineTitle` in the field bucket.
- **Examples:** the showcase zh-CN bundle translates both blocks of `showcase_task_overview` and the invoice / expense-report inline headings; the CRM zh-CN bundle translates the opportunity's product grid heading. Each key is translated at birth, so `check:i18n-coverage` stays at its baseline (527, none new).
- **Ledgers and generated files:** a `reports.blocks` liveness row with `label` / `description` children (translation 36 → 38 live), plus `gen:api-surface`, `gen:export-origins`, `gen:docs`, `gen:strictness-ledger`, `gen:liveness-counts` output.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-report-blocks.test.ts` (10): the slot at all three doors, the closed face, the `title` alias, the overlay, the BCP-47 ladder, reference identity, and the packaged-base rule per block.
- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-field-inline-title.test.ts` (7): the slot, a non-string refusal, the overlay through the type dispatch with no `unrecognized_keys`, no plural-label fallback, and the packaged-base rule.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-block-inline-title-walk.test.ts` (5): the extracted keys, unwritten strings recorded without being demanded, the bundle round trip, and coverage reporting both gaps and then clearing them.
- `examples/app-showcase/test/zh-cn-report-blocks-inline-titles.test.ts` (3): the acceptance pin for both cards, on the app's own metadata and bundle.

## Acceptance notes

- `validate-translation-references` (lint) checks that `reports.REPORT` names a real report, but it does not check that `blocks.BLOCK` names a real block of that report, so a mistyped block key resolves nothing without an orphan finding. This is noted, not filed.
- The joined renderer's `resolveText` reads an inline locale map's `default` only. That predates this change and is unrelated to the bundle path.
